policy: Hunt V4 is restricted to moneyline/ATS and requires every surviving rule to include at least one underused independent domain (strength context, value-weighted transactions, coach continuity, officials, starter individual impact or prior-season starter continuity). Thresholds are derived only from 2018-21; 2021-23 confirmation, 2023-24 validation and 2024-26 holdout are evaluation-only. Surviving candidates must remain profitable at worst executable historical prices overall and in holdout.
